import re

def parse(lines):
    ent = []
    eidx = []
    cnt = []
    cidx = []
    msg = []
    midx = []
    skip = []
    etype = None
    ename = None
    sec = ''
    pend = None
    summ = False
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        body = raw[1:] if raw[:1] in ('0', '1', '-', '+') else raw
        s = body.strip()
        if not s:
            if raw.strip():
                skip.append(i)
            continue
        if re.search(r'IDCAMS\s+SYSTEM SERVICES', body) or s.startswith('LISTCAT'):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(IDC\d+[A-Z])\s+(.*)$', s)
        if m:
            msg.append({'message_id': m.group(1), 'text': m.group(2)})
            midx.append(i)
            continue
        if s.startswith('THE NUMBER OF'):
            summ = 'ENTRIES PROCESSED' in s
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if summ:
            m = re.match(r'^([A-Z]+)\s+-+\s*(\d+)$', s)
            if m:
                cnt.append({'type': m.group(1), 'count': int(m.group(2))})
                cidx.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^ {0,4}([A-Z]+) -+ (\S+)\s*$', body)
        if m:
            etype = m.group(1)
            ename = m.group(2)
            sec = ''
            pend = None
            eidx.append(i)
            continue
        if etype is None:
            continue
        if re.match(r'^[A-Z][A-Z/-]*$', s):
            sec = s
            pend = None
            eidx.append(i)
            continue
        for ch in re.split(r'\s{2,}', s):
            ch = ch.strip()
            if not ch:
                continue
            pm = re.match(r'^(.+?)\s*-{2,}\s*(\S.*)$', ch)
            if pm:
                k, v = pm.group(1).strip(), pm.group(2).strip()
            else:
                km = re.match(r'^(\S+):$', ch)
                if km:
                    pend = km.group(1)
                    continue
                if pend:
                    k, v = pend, ch
                    pend = None
                else:
                    k, v = 'flag', ch
            ent.append({'entry_type': etype, 'entry_name': ename, 'section': sec, 'key': k, 'value': v})
        eidx.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if eidx:
        blocks.append({'name': 'entries', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': eidx, 'records': ent})
    if cidx:
        blocks.append({'name': 'entries_processed', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': cidx, 'records': cnt})
    if midx:
        blocks.append({'name': 'messages', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': midx, 'records': msg})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
